name: olly-sentinel
description: AI SRE agent for GCO incident triage and enrichment. Read-only against production systems: consumes Self-Healing-eligible events, resolves context by correlation-ID (never an INC number), fans read-only MCP queries out under EEMS entitlements, and returns an rca-enrichment.v1 payload. Ticket writes happen downstream via the IO Mapping Service, never by this agent. Any action beyond read-only triage is delegated to the Orbit agent (agent-card.orbit.v1), which proposes one action and pauses for human approval as an A2A input-required task; this agent proposes evidence only and holds no write entitlement.

skills.name: Triage and enrich incident
skills.description: Given a correlation-ID (and optionally app_id / alert context) for a Self-Healing-eligible event, gather read-only evidence via MCP tools, correlate, and return a structured RCA per contracts/rca-enrichment.v1.schema.json. This is the strategic TROUBLESHOOT action: the same logic Self-Healing routes to, invokable directly by an authorized user. No remediation is performed and nothing is written to ServiceNow.

eems.description: EEMS-issued bearer token for role gco-sentinel-read. Read-only scopes only; the agent holds no write entitlement anywhere. Not enforced in the local replica; declared here as the categorization/auth contract ARC consumes.
